quit_tasks_running:
{count} queued task(s) are still running.

Yes - quit now and stop the running task(s)
No - wait until they finish, then quit
Cancel - keep running
queue_empty: No tasks yet. Add one to have it run as soon as your quota allows.
queue_disabled: The task queue is off for this session because of an earlier error.
queue_no_gate: This account reports no five-hour quota, so no task will start.
queue_detail_no_log: This task has not run yet, so there is no log.
queue_stop_confirm:
Stop "{name}"?

The run is recorded as exit 143 and will not start again.
Only the Claude process itself is stopped - anything it started may keep running.
queue_prompt_caveat: The print-mode caveat is appended automatically.
queue_field_threshold: Start when five-hour usage is at or below
queue_threshold_hint: Usage is {pct}% right now, so this task would start on the next poll.
queue_threshold_hint_wait: Usage is {pct}% right now, so this task would wait.
queue_permission_warning: Queued tasks run with --dangerously-skip-permissions. Only queue prompts you would let run unsupervised.
queue_delete_confirm:
Delete "{name}" from the task file?

Its run record and log file are kept, so the id stays used up.
queue_warn_already_run: A run is already recorded for this id, so it will not start again until that record is removed.
queue_error_delete_running: This task is running. Stop it before deleting it.
registry_error_read: The task file cannot be read. Fix it by hand and restart.
registry_error_stale: The task file changed on disk. Close and reopen the popup to reload it.
registry_error_invalid: Nothing was written - these problems have to be fixed first:
registry_error_write: The task file could not be written.
connection_error: Could not connect to Anthropic API.
auth_expired: Session expired - please open Claude Code to log in again.
auth_expired_short: Please open Claude Code to refresh your session.
no_token: No OAuth token. Log in to Claude Code first.
warn_no_token: WARNING: No Claude Code OAuth token found!
warn_login: Please install and log in to Claude Code first:
notify_reset: Your quota has been reset. Claude is ready to use again.
already_running:
Auto Scheduler for Claude v{running_version} is already running.

Do you want to replace the running instance?
replace_failed:
The running instance could not be replaced.

Please close it manually and try again.
